item.title: The Chinese Voice Actor Forced to Prove He's Human
item.description:
📝 Since 2025, AI copies of Shen’s voice have spread so widely online that platforms have begun flagging his real recordings as synthetic. Worse, the more widely Shen’s cloned voice circulates, the more often he has to prove that his own recordings are real. But long before he became trapped in this Kafkaesque spiral, Shen had spent years turning his voice into a career.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sixthtone.com/news/1018753
